matches.note: A Royal Rumble-style match at two-minute intervals, eliminations by pinfall, submission or over the top rope to the floor, staged to crown a new UWA World Champion. Commissioner Sullivan announced before the bell that the last two men standing would then meet in a ladder match for the belt. The card announces thirty entrants; the surviving text names twenty-nine. No winner was declared: Carlos Canyeta's crossbody took the last four men over the top rope together, a replay showed all four touching the floor at the same time, and the Commissioner instead instated a four-way ladder match between them. Outcome recorded as unresolved rather than as a declared draw or no-contest, per the schema's own reservation of `result` for outcomes the served text explicitly declares.

matches.stipulation: UWA 'King of the Hill' Ladder Match
matches.note: For the vacant UWA World Championship, instated live on air after the Random Rumble ended with four men on the floor at once; the first man to pull the belt off a hoop suspended fifteen feet above the ring wins. The surviving copy of the document ends during the entrances, with Winston Steele announced first and in the ring, so the record does not name a winner.

notes: The UWA's own Random Rumble, staged at the CoreStates Center in Philadelphia and posted to the Prodigy service's WRESTLING BB on 24 February 1997. The document is held as NFW republished it in its own news archive; the served page carries the Prodigy message header verbatim, with a redaction where the poster's own identifier stood. The capture is incomplete — it ends mid-sentence during the ladder match's entrances.
